test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 14 Sept 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Six friends, F, G, H, J, K and L are having dinner sitting around a round table in a restaurant facing the center (but not necessarily in the same order). K is the immediate neighbor of H and J. F is sitting to the immediate right of H. L is to the immediate left of J. Who is sitting to the immediate right of G?
solution:
Given: Six friends, F, G, H, J, K and L. L is to the immediate left of J. Who is sitting to the immediate right of G 

1) F is sitting to the immediate right of H.

2) K is the immediate neighbor of H and J.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c48e291a0b0a0acd5e6faa4c7a0544e0bde218eefb4a0f8cf37394468538833d.png] 

3) L is to the immediate left of J. 

Thus final arrangement:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e04150de095268e6c911cdcf213c24d0689240322bfcb29a1e963815ff2d19a8.png] 

So, **L **is sitting to the immediate right of G. 

Hence, the correct answer is **"L".**
